newsitem.title: CHINA: China Jan-Sept aluminium output rises 2.17 pct.
newsitem.headline: China Jan-Sept aluminium output rises 2.17 pct.

text.p: China's output of aluminium rose by 2.17 percent in the first nine months of this year to total 1.2494 million tonnes, the China Securities newspaper said on Wednesday.
Output in September alone was 152,300 tonnes, up by 3.04 percent compared with August, the newspaper said, quoting figures from the State Statistical Bureau.
The bureau had apparently revised output for August.
Output of aluminium materials in January-September was 603,800 tonnes, up by 15.49 percent compared with the year-ago period, the newspaper said.
Production in September alone was 71,800 tonnes, up by 12.89 percent compared with August, it said.
Output of alumina was 1.8917 million tonnes in January-September, up by 18.56 percent year-on-year, the newspaper said.
Production of alumina in September alone was 244,600 tonnes, rising by 17.26 percent compared with August, it said.
